candidates.description: The original study claimed that the rs9600079 locus was associated with prostate cancer risk in men of Japanese ancestry.
candidates.citation_sentence: Takata and colleagues conducted a GWAS in a Japanese population and identified 5 novel loci with allele frequencies ranging between 0.36 and 0.44 [2].
candidates.notes: The replication found no association for rs9600079 and explicitly states that this SNP did not replicate. The cited sentence identifies the original study but gives the year only through reference [2], not in the sentence itself.
